name: Usage Logger
description: Logs agent telemetry to an Obsidian vault as a markdown table

logPath.description: Log file path, relative to the workspace directory.

maxPromptLen.description: Truncate logged prompts to this many characters (0 = no limit).

maxTrackedRuns.description: Maximum in-flight turns held in memory.

maxPendingCalls.description: Maximum staged tool calls held in memory.

flushDelayMs.description: Delay between agent_end and writing the row, so late llm_output events are included.

inboundClaimWindowMs.description: How long a group-chat inbound message stays claimable by a later agent run.
